body:
## What it does

Sells for you on European resale platforms, taking a listing from first enquiry to an agreed price. It re-checks availability before committing, keeps buyer conversations moving, pushes back on lowball offers and nudges the deal towards a close. Because it can agree sales on your behalf, it is worth supervising.

## Before you install

Open the share link and read the instructions it carries before you add it. @SuperTost100 shared this one publicly, and adding it copies the setup into your own account rather than giving you access to theirs.
